articles.title_en: The impact of neonatal care on moderate-risk infants: Evidence from healthcare use in the first two years of life
articles.title_cn: 新生儿护理对中等风险婴儿的影响：生命最初两年医疗保健使用的证据
articles.abstract_en: Advances in evidence-based neonatal care have led to large improvements in the survival rates of high-risk newborns. Yet studies have documented wide variation in the care of more prevalent moderate-risk infants, who comprise a much larger proportion of admissions to neonatal care. In this study, we build on a small literature which uses quasi-experimental design to understand the impact of neonatal care, and for the first time, examine this moderate-risk cohort of infants. We use individual-level data on the full population of births in the state of New South Wales, Australia to examine the impact of neonatal care on the healthcare use of moderate-risk infants in the first two years of life. We implement a regression discontinuity design exploiting admission protocols based on birthweight among neonatal units of three different and explicit levels of capability. Unlike previous studies, which examine differences in outcomes across the high-risk cut-off at 1500 g, our study examines differences for moderate-risk infants born near birthweight cut-offs closer to normal birth weight (2500 g). While admission to the neonatal unit jumps across the cut-off, we find modest impacts on downstream healthcare use, including both in-hospital and out-of-hospital care. However, we identify heterogeneous effects across varying capability levels. Moderate risk infants admitted to lower capability neonatal units received more cost-intensive care, resulting in reduced healthcare use following discharge from hospital, while the same was not observed for those admitted to the highest capability units. We suggest that this is due to more aggressive clinical management at lower capability units, and leave this as a priority for future research.
articles.abstract_cn: 基于证据的新生儿护理的进步已大幅提高了高风险新生儿的存活率。然而，研究记录了更为普遍的中等风险婴儿护理中的广泛差异，这些婴儿在新生儿护理入院中占更大比例。在本研究中，我们基于少量使用准实验设计来理解新生儿护理影响的文献，并首次考察这一中等风险婴儿群体。我们使用澳大利亚新南威尔士州全人口出生个体层面数据，考察新生儿护理对中等风险婴儿生命最初两年医疗保健使用的影响。我们实施回归不连续设计，利用基于出生体重的新生儿病房入院协议，涉及三个不同且明确的能力水平。与以往研究考察高风险临界值1500克附近结果的差异不同，我们的研究考察接近正常出生体重临界值2500克的中等风险婴儿的差异。虽然新生儿病房入院在临界值处跳跃，我们发现对下游医疗保健使用的影响温和，包括院内和院外护理。然而，我们识别出不同能力水平下的异质性效应。入住较低能力新生儿病房的中等风险婴儿接受了更多成本密集型护理，导致出院后医疗保健使用减少，而入住最高能力病房的婴儿则未观察到同样情况。我们认为这是由于较低能力病房更积极的临床管理所致，并将其留作未来研究的优先事项。

articles.title_en: Price transparency in healthcare: Bargaining incentives and patient responses
articles.title_cn: 医疗保健中的价格透明度：谈判激励与患者反应
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the impact of price transparency on healthcare prices, using a natural experiment involving the gradual disclosure of medical procedure prices on a state-run website. The study finds that negotiated allowed amounts decreased by 5.1% for surgical procedures and 9.1% for radiology procedures, which have higher average allowed amounts and attracted more price requests on the website. In contrast, for lab procedures, the evidence is mixed and does not point to a clear effect. The observed reductions are primarily driven by provider–insurer negotiations rather than patient price shopping. Price reductions were consistent across all providers and insurers, regardless of whether their prices were listed on the transparency website, and extended to providers in neighboring states.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用一个自然实验，即在一个州立网站上逐步公开医疗程序价格，研究了价格透明度对医疗价格的影响。研究发现，手术程序的协商允许金额下降了5.1%，放射科程序下降了9.1%，这些程序的平均允许金额较高，并在网站上吸引了更多的价格查询。相比之下，对于实验室程序，证据混杂，并未指向明确的效果。观察到的降价主要由提供者与保险公司之间的谈判驱动，而非患者的比价购物。价格下降在所有提供者和保险公司中保持一致，无论其价格是否列在透明度网站上，并且延伸到了邻近州的提供者。

articles.title_en: When women take over: Physician gender and health care provision
articles.title_cn: 当女性接管：医生性别与医疗服务提供
articles.abstract_en: The share of female physicians has risen in OECD countries in recent decades, but we know little about the effects of physician gender on patient health care use. We exploit quasi-random assignment of primary care providers (PCPs) to existing PCP practices and patients and estimate the causal effect of female PCPs on health care provision. Using Austrian register data and a difference-in-differences strategy, we find that female PCPs generate 15% less revenue and see 7% fewer patients than male PCPs. Shifting the focus to patient-level outcomes, we observe that health care utilization remains largely unchanged following assignment to a female physician. However, results show that patients are more likely to leave PCP practices with female successors. Our results do not support the idea that the decision to change PCP is driven by preferences against being treated by female physicians. Instead, our analysis suggests that the observed differences are partly explained by female PCPs working fewer hours, especially those facing working time restrictions. As the share of female physicians continues to rise, measures to increase work flexibility may be necessary to maintain broad access to outpatient health care.
articles.abstract_cn: 近几十年来，OECD国家的女性医生比例有所上升，但我们对医生性别对患者医疗服务使用的影响知之甚少。我们利用初级保健提供者（PCP）对现有PCP诊所和患者的准随机分配，估计女性PCP对医疗服务提供的因果效应。使用奥地利注册数据并采用双重差分策略，我们发现女性PCP产生的收入比男性PCP低15%，接诊的患者少7%。将焦点转向患者层面的结果，我们观察到在分配给女性医生后，医疗服务利用基本保持不变。然而，结果显示患者更可能离开由女性继任者接管的PCP诊所。我们的结果不支持患者更换PCP的决定是由反对女性医生治疗的偏好所驱动的观点。相反，我们的分析表明，观察到的差异部分归因于女性PCP工作时间较少，尤其是那些面临工作时间限制的医生。随着女性医生比例的持续上升，可能需要采取措施提高工作灵活性，以维持门诊医疗服务的广泛可及性。

articles.title_en: Legal status and voluntary abortions by immigrants
articles.title_cn: 合法身份与移民妇女的自愿堕胎
articles.abstract_en: We estimate the effect of granting legal status to immigrant women on voluntary abortions. We exploit the 2007 EU enlargement as an exogenous shock to legal status for Romanian and Bulgarian women, considering Italy as a destination country. Using a standard Difference-in-Differences model, we estimate a decline between 60% and 70% in voluntary pregnancy termination (VPT) rates for the new EU citizens from the two Eastern countries. We also introduce a novel framework to separate the total effect of the enlargement into a “citizenship” effect due to (legal or illegal) migrants already present in Italy and a “selection” effect due to new flows of immigrants. We show that the findings are robust to several alternative explanations. The drop in abortions points to legal status as a way to empower immigrant women.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们估计了授予移民妇女合法身份对自愿堕胎的影响。我们利用2007年欧盟扩大作为罗马尼亚和保加利亚妇女合法身份的外生冲击，以意大利为目的地国家。使用标准的双重差分模型，我们估计这两个东欧国家的新欧盟公民的自愿终止妊娠率下降了60%至70%。我们还引入了一个新颖的框架，将扩大的总效应分解为“公民身份”效应（由于已在意大利的合法或非法移民）和“选择”效应（由于新的移民流入）。我们表明，这些发现对多种替代解释是稳健的。堕胎率的下降表明合法身份是增强移民妇女权能的一种方式。

articles.title_en: Does knowing the costs of other physicians affect doctors’ referrals?
articles.title_cn: 了解其他医生的费用是否会影响医生的转诊？
articles.abstract_en: Patient referrals from primary care physicians (PCPs) to specialists are common in the American health care industry, but are typically made without any knowledge of relative specialist costs. In this study, I estimate the effect of providing such information to PCPs on referral patterns. Implementing a field experiment with an Independent Practice Association (IPA), I sent a list of average costs for new ophthalmology referrals to randomly chosen primary care medical practices. Using administrative referral data, I find that PCPs increased referral share to less costly ophthalmology practices during the first two months after treatment by 4.6 percentage points for each reduction in costliness rank (e.g., each rank closer to the least expensive). Effects were only found for patients for whom the PCPs had cost reduction incentives, and dissipated over the following four months. For the patients whose referrals were affected, I estimate that the expected cost to the IPA of a referral to ophthalmology fell during the first two months by about $80 (45% of pre-intervention referral cost).
articles.abstract_cn: 在美国医疗行业中，初级保健医生（PCPs）向专科医生的患者转诊很常见，但通常在不知道专科医生相对费用的情况下进行。在本研究中，我估计了向初级保健医生提供此类信息对转诊模式的影响。通过与独立执业协会（IPA）实施一项实地实验，我向随机选择的初级保健医疗诊所发送了一份新眼科转诊的平均费用清单。利用行政转诊数据，我发现，在治疗后的前两个月内，初级保健医生增加了向费用较低的眼科诊所的转诊份额，每降低一个费用等级（例如，每接近最便宜的一个等级），转诊份额增加4.6个百分点。这种效应仅出现在初级保健医生有费用降低激励的患者中，并在接下来的四个月内逐渐消失。对于转诊受到影响的病人，我估计在头两个月内，IPA眼科转诊的预期费用下降了约$80（占干预前转诊费用的45%）。

articles.title_en: Imprecise health beliefs and health behavior
articles.title_cn: 不精确的健康信念与健康行为
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines belief imprecision in the context of COVID-19, when uncertainty about health outcomes was widespread. We survey a sample of young adults a few months after the onset of the pandemic. We elicit individuals’ minimum and maximum subjective probabilities of different health outcomes, and define belief imprecision as the range between these values. We document substantial heterogeneity in the degree of imprecision across respondents, which remains largely unexplained by standard demographic characteristics. To assess the behavioral impact of imprecise beliefs, we ask beliefs about future outcomes under hypothetical scenarios that feature different levels of protective behaviors. We find that individuals who expect protective behaviors to reduce not only the subjective probability of a negative health outcome, but also the degree of imprecision associated with it, behave more protectively.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文在COVID-19背景下考察了信念的不精确性，当时健康结果的不确定性普遍存在。我们在疫情爆发几个月后对一组年轻成年人进行了调查。我们引出了个体对不同健康结果的最小和最大主观概率，并将信念不精确性定义为这些值之间的范围。我们记录了受访者之间不精确程度的显著异质性，这种异质性在很大程度上无法由标准人口统计学特征解释。为了评估不精确信念的行为影响，我们询问了在具有不同保护行为水平的假设情景下对未来结果的信念。我们发现，那些预期保护行为不仅能降低负面健康结果的主观概率，还能降低与之相关的不精确程度的个体，其行为更具保护性。

articles.title_en: Absence from work and lifetime smoking behavior: Evidence from European maternal leave policies
articles.title_cn: 工作缺勤与终身吸烟行为：来自欧洲产假政策的证据
articles.abstract_en: We provide new evidence on how child-related career interruptions affect long-term health behaviors by examining the impact of maternal leave duration on smoking habits across 14 European countries. Linking data on maternity and parental leave policies from 1960 to 2010 with survey data on mothers’ health behaviors, birth, and employment histories, we identify the effects of absence from work due to child birth on lifetime smoking in an instrumental variable framework based on within- and between-country variations in policies. We find that a one-month increase in leave duration raises the probability of a mother smoking later in life by 1.2 percentage points. Additionally, a one-month increase in child-related absence from work extends the lifetime duration of smoking by 7 months, the number of cigarettes smoked per day by 0.2 cigarettes, and the number of pack years by 0.6. We document potential non-linearities in these effects, suggesting that shorter leave durations may have a protective effect, while very long absence from work could promote harmful health behaviors. Heterogeneity analyses reveal that the observed effects are mediated by the partners’ lack of financial support around childbirth, while employment status and other socio-demographic characteristics do not play a significant role.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过考察产假时长对14个欧洲国家吸烟习惯的影响，提供了关于与子女相关的职业中断如何影响长期健康行为的新证据。将1960年至2010年的产假和育儿假政策数据与母亲健康行为、生育和就业历史的调查数据相结合，我们利用基于政策国内及跨国差异的工具变量框架，识别了因生育导致的工作缺勤对终身吸烟的影响。我们发现，产假时长每增加一个月，母亲晚年吸烟的概率提高1.2个百分点。此外，与子女相关的工作缺勤每增加一个月，终身吸烟持续时间延长7个月，每日吸烟数量增加0.2支，吸烟包年数增加0.6。我们记录了这些效应中潜在的非线性关系，表明较短的产假时长可能具有保护作用，而非常长的工作缺勤可能促进有害健康行为。异质性分析显示，观察到的效应由伴侣在生育期间缺乏经济支持所中介，而就业状况和其他社会人口特征并未发挥显著作用。

articles.title_en: Regression and decomposition with ordinal health outcomes
articles.title_cn: 有序健康结果的回归与分解
articles.abstract_en: Although ordinal health outcome values are categories like “poor” health or “moderate” depression, they are often assigned values 1,2,3,… for convenience. We provide results on interpretation of subsequent analysis based on ordinary least squares (OLS) regression. For description, unlike for prediction, the OLS estimand’s interpretation does not require that the 1,2,3,… are cardinal values: it is always the “best linear approximation” of a summary of the conditional survival functions. Further, for Blinder–Oaxaca-type decomposition, the OLS-based estimator is numerically equivalent to a certain counterfactual-based decomposition of the survival function, again regardless of any cardinal values. Empirically, with 2022 U.S. data for working-age adults, we estimate a higher incidence of depression in the rural population, and we decompose the rural–urban difference. Including a nonparametric estimator that we describe, estimators agree that 33%–39% of the rural–urban difference is statistically explained by income, education, age, sex, and geographic region. The OLS-based detailed decomposition shows this is mostly from income.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管有序健康结果值如“差”健康或“中度”抑郁等类别，但为了方便，它们常被赋值为1、2、3等。我们提供了基于普通最小二乘（OLS）回归的后续分析解释结果。对于描述而言，与预测不同，OLS估计量的解释并不要求1、2、3等是基数数值：它始终是条件生存函数汇总的“最佳线性近似”。此外，对于Blinder–Oaxaca型分解，基于OLS的估计量在数值上等同于某种基于反事实的生存函数分解，同样与任何基数数值无关。实证上，使用2022年美国工作年龄成人数据，我们估计农村人口中抑郁发生率更高，并分解了农村与城市之间的差异。包括我们描述的非参数估计器在内，估计器一致认为，农村与城市差异的33%–39%在统计上可由收入、教育、年龄、性别和地理区域解释。基于OLS的详细分解显示，这主要来自收入。

articles.title_en: The effect of e-cigarette flavor bans on tobacco use
articles.title_cn: 电子烟口味禁令对烟草使用的影响
articles.abstract_en: Advocates for sales restrictions on flavored e-cigarettes argue that flavors appeal to young people and lead them down a path to nicotine addiction. Using data from a variety of surveys (Youth Risk Behavior Surveys, Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance Survey, and Population Assessment of Tobacco and Health), this study is among the first to examine the effect of state and local restrictions on the sale of flavored electronic nicotine delivery system (ENDS) products on youth and young adult tobacco use. We find robust evidence that the adoption of an ENDS flavor restriction reduces short-run frequent and everyday ENDS use among youths by approximately two-to-three percentage-points. Some evidence suggests that this effect weakens after two years. We also document reductions in ENDS use among young adults aged 18-30 that appear to strengthen after two years. Finally, evidence suggests substitution from flavored ENDS to unflavored ENDS and cigarettes among certain age groups.
articles.abstract_cn: 支持对调味电子烟实施销售限制的倡导者认为，口味吸引年轻人，并引导他们走向尼古丁成瘾的道路。利用多项调查数据（青少年风险行为调查、行为风险因素监测调查以及烟草与健康人口评估），本研究是首批考察州和地方对调味电子尼古丁输送系统（ENDS）产品销售限制对青少年和年轻人烟草使用影响的研究之一。我们发现强有力的证据表明，实施ENDS口味限制会使青少年短期内的频繁和日常ENDS使用率降低约二至三个百分点。一些证据表明，这一效果在两年后减弱。我们还记录了18至30岁年轻人中ENDS使用的减少，这种减少在两年后似乎有所加强。最后，证据表明某些年龄组从调味ENDS转向无味ENDS和卷烟。

articles.title_en: High speed internet and the widening gender gap in adolescent mental health: Evidence from Spanish hospital records
articles.title_cn: 高速互联网与青少年心理健康性别差距的扩大：来自西班牙医院记录的证据
articles.abstract_en: We exploit variations in fiber optic (FTTH) deployment to assess the impact of high-speed internet access on adolescent mental health. Our findings reveal that FTTH access increases addictive Internet usage and reduces time allocated to sleep, homework, as well as social interactions with family and friends. Access to FTTH increases mental health diagnoses in hospitals and contributes to a notable rise in adolescent suicide rates, particularly among girls. As new platforms and apps gain traction among adolescents, understanding the impact of connectivity improvement becomes important. This is especially relevant given the current FTTH growth replacing older broadband technologies.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用光纤到户（FTTH）部署的差异来评估高速互联网接入对青少年心理健康的影响。我们的研究结果显示，FTTH接入增加了成瘾性互联网使用，并减少了用于睡眠、家庭作业以及与家人和朋友社交互动的时间。FTTH接入增加了医院中的心理健康诊断，并导致青少年自杀率显著上升，尤其是在女孩中。随着新平台和应用在青少年中日益流行，理解连接改善的影响变得重要。鉴于当前FTTH增长正在取代较旧的宽带技术，这一点尤其相关。

articles.title_en: Mental health and mortality trends in the United States
articles.title_cn: 美国心理健康与死亡率趋势
articles.abstract_en: This study investigates whether worsening mental health has played a significant role in the rising mortality rates experienced by some population groups in the early 21st century, a question that has gained prominence with increased attention to so-called “deaths of despair.” The main takeaway is that although declining psychological health has likely contributed to adverse mortality trends—especially among prime-age non-Hispanic Whites—its overall impact is limited and not well captured by standard definitions of “deaths of despair.” Five key findings support this conclusion. First, mental health deteriorated between 1993 and 2019 for all population groups examined. Second, these declines are associated with higher predicted death rates and help explain worsening mortality trends for prime-age non-Hispanic Whites and, to a lesser extent, non-Hispanic Blacks between 1999 and 2019. Third, while these correlations lend some support to the broader idea of “deaths of despair,” the specific causes comprising them appear to be both more expansive and different from those previously emphasized. Fourth, heterogeneity in how worsening mental distress affects mortality—rather than in mental health trends themselves—is more important in explaining Black-White disparities in its overall impact. Finally, in the primary specifications, deteriorating mental health accounts for an estimated 9 % to 29 % of the rise in mortality rates among prime-age Whites in recent years.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了心理健康状况恶化是否在21世纪初某些人群死亡率上升中发挥了重要作用，这一问题因对所谓“绝望之死”的关注增加而日益突出。主要结论是，尽管心理健康的下降可能对不利的死亡率趋势有所贡献——尤其是在壮年非西班牙裔白人中——但其总体影响有限，且未被“绝望之死”的标准定义充分捕捉。五个关键发现支持这一结论。第一，从1993年到2019年，所有被考察人群的心理健康均出现恶化。第二，这些下降与更高的预测死亡率相关，并有助于解释1999年至2019年间壮年非西班牙裔白人以及较小程度上非西班牙裔黑人的死亡率恶化趋势。第三，虽然这些相关性在一定程度上支持了“绝望之死”的更广泛概念，但构成该概念的具体死因似乎比先前强调的更为广泛且有所不同。第四，心理困扰恶化对死亡率影响的异质性——而非心理健康趋势本身的异质性——在解释黑人与白人在总体影响上的差异方面更为重要。最后，在主要规格中，心理健康恶化估计占近年来壮年白人死亡率上升的9%至29%。

articles.title_en: Living alone and provider behaviour in public and private hospitals
articles.title_cn: 独居和公立和私立医院的医疗服务提供者行为
articles.abstract_en: Following COVID-19, hospitals in many OECD countries are under pressure to absorb backlogs accumulated due to the suspension of health services. Reductions in length of stay can generate capacity to treat patients and increase efficiency. Personal circumstances, such as living alone, can affect how long patients stay in hospital. We test whether such non-clinical factors affect care received by patients. Several countries are experiencing an increase in the number of elderly people who live alone. Patients who live alone may lack support at home leading to delayed discharges despite being clinically fit. We test whether living alone affects length of stay of publicly-funded patients treated by public and private hospitals requiring hip replacement, a common planned surgery, in England. Private providers have stronger incentives to contain costs, which could reduce the extent to which non-clinical factors such as living alone are taken into account when providers discharge patients. Using administrative data and controlling for a rich set of patient characteristics, and hospital and local supply factors, we provide evidence that living alone increases length of stay. The effect is substantive and larger for public hospitals and older patients. It is similar for patients living in urban and rural areas, and across socioeconomic status. More broadly, the study shows that non-clinical factors can affect the care received by patients.
articles.abstract_cn: 在新冠肺炎疫情19之后，许多经合组织国家的医院面临着吸收因卫生服务暂停而积累的积压案件的压力。住院时间的缩短可以产生治疗患者的能力并提高效率。个人情况（例如独居）可能会影响患者住院的时间。我们测试这些非临床因素是否会影响患者接受的护理。一些国家的独居老年人数量正在增加。尽管临床状况良好，独居患者可能缺乏家中支持，导致出院延迟。我们测试了独居是否会影响英国公立和私立医院接受髋关节置换术（一种常见计划手术）的公共资助患者的住院时间。私人医疗服务提供者有更强的动机来控制成本，这可能会减少医疗服务提供者在让患者出院时考虑独居等非临床因素的程度。使用管理数据并控制丰富的患者特征以及医院和当地供应因素，我们提供了独居会增加住院时间的证据。对于公立医院和老年患者来说，效果是实质性的、更大的。对于生活在城市和农村地区以及不同社会经济地位的患者来说，情况都是相似的。更广泛地说，研究表明非临床因素会影响患者接受的护理。

articles.title_en: Responsibility-sensitive welfare weights for health
articles.title_cn: 健康的责任敏感福利权重
articles.abstract_en: We estimate welfare weights for health to facilitate program evaluation allowing for aversion to health inequality and to health inequity by three non-health characteristics. In a UK general population sample, 569 online experiment participants distribute constrained resources to determine the health of hypothetical individuals distinguished by randomly generated resource productivity as well as sex, income and smoking (41,460 observations). We elicit beliefs about responsibility for income and smoking, and use their associations with the allocations to estimate responsibility-sensitive weights for health by those two characteristics. We find weak prioritisation of females’ health, moderate prioritisation of the health of poorer individuals and strong prioritisation of the health of non-smokers over that of smokers. Substantial aversion to health inequality lowers weights on females and non-smokers, who are health-advantaged, and raises the weight on the poor, who are health-disadvantaged. As beliefs about responsibility for income and smoking strengthen, weights on the poor decrease and weights on non-smokers significantly increase.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们估计健康的福利权重，以促进项目评估，允许对健康不平等和由三个非健康特征导致的健康不公平的厌恶。在英国一般人群样本中，569名在线实验参与者分配受限资源，以确定由随机生成的资源生产力以及性别、收入和吸烟状况区分的假设个体的健康（41,460个观测值）。我们引出了关于收入和吸烟责任的信念，并利用这些信念与分配的关联来估计按这两个特征划分的健康责任敏感权重。我们发现对女性健康的优先关注较弱，对较贫困个体健康的优先关注中等，对非吸烟者健康相对于吸烟者的优先关注强烈。对健康不平等的显著厌恶降低了女性和非吸烟者（健康优势群体）的权重，并提高了贫困者（健康劣势群体）的权重。随着对收入和吸烟责任信念的增强，贫困者的权重下降，而非吸烟者的权重显著增加。

articles.title_en: Technology regulation reconsidered: The effects of certificate of need policies on the quantity and quality of diagnostic imaging
articles.title_cn: 技术监管再思考：需求证明政策对诊断影像数量与质量的影响
articles.abstract_en: Estimates of the impact of Certificate of Need (CON) laws on medical care have been inconsistent, possibly because not all CON laws apply to all services. Using an original dataset identifying imaging-related CON laws and a regression discontinuity design at state borders, we estimate the effects of CON on the use and quality of diagnostic imaging. Medicare beneficiaries in regulated states are less likely to receive any image and even less likely to receive low-value imaging than beneficiaries in unregulated states. High-value imaging is unaffected. Overall, CON for imaging reduces low-value care and leaves high-value care unchanged.
articles.abstract_cn: 关于需求证明（CON）法律对医疗服务影响的估计结果一直不一致，这可能是因为并非所有CON法律都适用于所有服务。利用一个识别影像相关CON法律的原始数据集，并在州边界采用断点回归设计，我们估计了CON对诊断影像使用和质量的影响。受监管州的医疗保险受益者接受任何影像检查的可能性较低，且接受低价值影像检查的可能性甚至更低，相比之下，未受监管州的受益者则不然。高价值影像检查未受影响。总体而言，针对影像的CON减少了低价值医疗服务，同时使高价值医疗服务保持不变。

articles.title_en: A change of plans: Switching costs in the procurement of health insurance
articles.title_cn: 计划变更：健康保险采购中的转换成本
articles.abstract_en: The provision of public health insurance through regulated markets requires a dynamic procurement of insurers over time. Using data from Medicaid managed care bids, I study the impacts of regulators’ decision to drop an insurer from the market on health care use among affected enrollees, who must switch to another health plan. Using a difference-in-differences framework, I find that after a plan is replaced, enrollees from the exiting plan have fewer visits to primary care physicians, lower utilization of prescription drugs, including those for chronic conditions, and more hospital admissions. These disruptions disproportionately affect sicker enrollees, particularly children and non-white beneficiaries. In the year following the exit, insurers’ spending on enrollees from exiting plans is 7% lower than the pre-exit baseline. Changes in provider networks and drug formularies may serve as mechanisms.
articles.abstract_cn: 通过受监管市场提供公共健康保险需要随时间对保险公司进行动态采购。利用医疗补助管理护理投标数据，我研究了监管机构决定将一家保险公司从市场中剔除对受影响参保者医疗保健使用的影响，这些参保者必须转向另一个健康计划。采用双重差分框架，我发现当一个计划被替换后，来自退出计划的参保者看初级保健医生的次数减少，处方药（包括慢性病用药）的使用率降低，住院次数增加。这些干扰对病情较重的参保者影响尤为显著，特别是儿童和非白人受益者。在退出后的那一年，保险公司对来自退出计划参保者的支出比退出前基线低7%。提供者网络和药物处方的变化可能是其作用机制。

articles.title_en: The Effect of E-Cigarette Taxes on Substance Use
articles.title_cn: 电子烟税对物质使用的影响
articles.abstract_en: Public health advocates warn that the rapid growth of legal markets for electronic nicotine delivery systems (ENDS) may generate a “gateway” to marijuana and harder drug consumption, particularly among teenagers. This study explores the effects of ENDS taxes on substance use. Analyses are based on difference-in-differences and event-study methods applied to both survey (Youth Risk Behavior Surveillance System and Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System) and administrative (Treatment Episode Data Set) data. Our results imply that a one-dollar increase in ENDS taxes (2023$) is associated with a 1.0 to 1.5 percentage point decline in teen marijuana use and in co-use of ENDS and marijuana. This result is consistent with e-cigarettes and marijuana being economic complements. We also find that youth responses to ENDS taxes, in terms of their ENDS use and spillovers into marijuana use, appear to moderate over the longer term. We find no evidence that ENDS taxes affect drug treatment admissions or consumption of illicit drugs other than marijuana such as cocaine, methamphetamine, or opioids.
articles.abstract_cn: 公共卫生倡导者警告说，电子尼古丁输送系统（ENDS）合法市场的快速增长可能为青少年吸食大麻和更烈性毒品打开“门户”。本研究探讨了ENDS税对物质使用的影响。分析基于双重差分和事件研究方法，应用于调查数据（青少年风险行为监测系统和行为风险因素监测系统）和行政数据（治疗事件数据集）。我们的结果表明，ENDS税每增加一美元（按2023年美元计算），青少年大麻使用以及ENDS与大麻同时使用的比例下降1.0至1.5个百分点。这一结果与电子烟和大麻在经济上具有互补性相一致。我们还发现，青少年对ENDS税的反应，就其ENDS使用及对大麻使用的溢出效应而言，在长期内似乎趋于缓和。我们没有发现ENDS税影响药物滥用治疗入院或除大麻以外的非法药物（如可卡因、甲基苯丙胺或阿片类药物）消费的证据。

articles.title_en: The impact of the Female Secondary School Stipend Program on child health
articles.title_cn: 女性中学助学金计划对儿童健康的影响
articles.abstract_en: In this study, we examine the inter-generational effects of the 1994 Female Secondary School Stipend Program (FSSSP) on child health inputs and child health outcomes in Bangladesh. Prior studies have shown that the FSSSP significantly increased secondary schooling among rural girls. Applying a difference-in-differences model based on differential exposure to FSSSP by birth cohort and rural residence, we find that full immunization rates increased by 4.2 percentage points among children of mothers eligible for a stipend for 5 years relative to children of mothers who were not eligible, but there were no significant effects for children of mothers eligible for a stipend for only 2 years. We also find improvements in other health inputs (e.g., antenatal care) and in child health outcomes (e.g., mortality). We also explore changes in marriage, fertility, autonomy, labor supply, and media exposure, which may contribute to the observed improvements in child health.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本研究中，我们考察了1994年女性中学助学金计划（FSSSP）对孟加拉国儿童健康投入和儿童健康结果的代际影响。先前的研究表明，FSSSP显著提高了农村女孩的中学教育水平。应用基于出生队列和农村居住地对FSSSP不同暴露程度的双重差分模型，我们发现，相对于母亲不符合助学金条件的儿童，符合5年助学金条件的母亲的儿童完全免疫率提高了4.2个百分点，但仅符合2年助学金条件的母亲的儿童没有显著影响。我们还发现其他健康投入（如产前保健）和儿童健康结果（如死亡率）有所改善。我们还探讨了婚姻、生育、自主权、劳动供给和媒体接触的变化，这些可能有助于观察到的儿童健康改善。

articles.title_en: Back to school: The effect of school visits during COVID-19 on COVID-19 outcomes
articles.title_cn: 重返校园：COVID-19期间学校访问对COVID-19结果的影响
articles.abstract_en: The effects of school closures on COVID-19 transmission remain unclear, even after the conclusion of the national Public Health Emergency. We use healthcare claims data from 130 million household-week observations linked to smartphone mobility data to measure the effects of changes in county-level visits to schools on COVID-19 outcomes. We use a triple-differences approach that leverages within-county differences in exposure between families with and without school-age children and find modest impacts. We find increases in COVID-19 infection rates, with larger differences in low-income and higher COVID-19 prevalence counties.
articles.abstract_cn: 学校关闭对COVID-19传播的影响仍不明确，即使在国家公共卫生紧急状态结束后也是如此。我们使用与智能手机移动数据相关联的130亿户周观察的医疗保健索赔数据，来衡量县级学校访问变化对COVID-19结果的影响。我们采用三重差分方法，利用县内有无学龄儿童家庭之间暴露差异，发现影响温和。我们发现COVID-19感染率上升，在低收入和COVID-19高流行县中差异更大。

articles.title_en: Do for-profit hospitals cream-skim patients? Evidence from inpatient psychiatric care in California
articles.title_cn: 营利性医院是否挑选患者？来自加利福尼亚州住院精神科护理的证据
articles.abstract_en: The paper examines whether, among inpatient psychiatric admissions in California, for-profit (FP) hospitals engage in cream skimming, i.e., selecting patients for some characteristic(s) other than their need for care, which enhances the profitability of the provider. We propose a novel approach to identifying cream skimming using cost outcomes. Naïve treatment effect estimates of hospital ownership type consist of the combined effects of differential patient case mix (selection) and hospital cost containment strategies (execution). In contrast, an instrumental variable (IV) approach can control for case mix and establish the causal effects of ownership type due to its execution. We interpret the difference between the naïve and IV treatment effects to be driven by FP hospitals’ selection based on unobserved patient case mix. Our findings on patient selection show that FP hospitals are more likely than their not-for-profit (NFP) counterparts to admit higher-cost patients (who tend to be less profitable under the existing inpatient psychiatric care payment systems), providing no evidence of cream skimming by FP hospitals. Furthermore, our estimates of hospital execution indicate that FP hospitals are more likely than NFP hospitals to deliver inpatient services at lower costs. These results may alleviate concerns about the recent proliferation of FP psychiatric hospitals, particularly regarding cream skimming in this market.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了在加利福尼亚州的住院精神病患者中，营利性（FP）医院是否进行“挑奶皮”行为，即根据除护理需求以外的某种或某些特征选择患者，从而提升提供者的盈利能力。我们提出了一种利用成本结果识别挑奶皮行为的新方法。医院所有权类型的朴素处理效应估计包含了患者病例组合差异（选择）与医院成本控制策略（执行）的联合效应。相比之下，工具变量（IV）方法可以控制病例组合，并建立所有权类型因其执行而产生的因果效应。我们将朴素处理效应与IV处理效应之间的差异解释为FP医院基于未观察到的患者病例组合进行的选择所致。我们对患者选择的研究结果表明，FP医院比非营利性（NFP）医院更有可能接收高成本患者（在现有住院精神科护理支付体系下，这些患者往往利润较低），因此没有证据表明FP医院存在挑奶皮行为。此外，我们对医院执行的估计表明，FP医院比NFP医院更有可能以较低成本提供住院服务。这些结果可能缓解对近期FP精神病医院激增的担忧，尤其是关于该市场中挑奶皮行为的担忧。

articles.title_en: Regional variation in mental healthcare utilization and suicide: Evidence from movers in Australia
articles.title_cn: 精神卫生保健利用与自杀的地区差异：来自澳大利亚迁移者的证据
articles.abstract_en: Poor mental health is a major global health issue, with many countries documenting high levels of unmet need and regional disparities in mental healthcare utilization. To determine how best to address these disparities, it is important to understand what drives regional variation. Using Census-linked microdata from Australia, we exploit cross-region migration to identify the extent to which patient and place factors drive regional variation in utilization of mental healthcare services and mental health prescriptions (antidepressants, anxiolytics, antipsychotics). We find that place factors account for approximately 72 % and 19 % of the regional variation in utilization of mental healthcare services and mental health prescriptions, respectively, with the rest reflecting patient-related demand. We also find suggestive evidence that larger place effects predict fewer mental health related Emergency Department presentations, self-harm hospitalizations, and suicides. Altogether, our findings suggest there is inadequate and inequitable supply in regions with low utilization, rather than inefficiently high utilization in high utilization regions.
articles.abstract_cn: 精神健康状况不佳是一个重大的全球健康问题，许多国家记录了精神卫生保健利用方面的高水平未满足需求和地区差异。为了确定如何最好地解决这些差异，理解地区差异的驱动因素至关重要。利用澳大利亚的人口普查关联微观数据，我们利用跨地区迁移来识别患者因素和地区因素在多大程度上驱动精神卫生保健服务利用和精神科处方药（抗抑郁药、抗焦虑药、抗精神病药）的地区差异。我们发现，地区因素分别约占精神卫生保健服务利用地区差异的72%和精神科处方药地区差异的19%，其余部分反映了与患者相关的需求。我们还发现了提示性证据，表明较大的地区效应预示着较少的精神健康相关的急诊科就诊、自伤住院和自杀。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，在利用率低的地区存在供应不足和不公平，而非高利用率地区的利用效率过高。

articles.title_en: Heterogeneous peer effects and gender-based interventions for teenage obesity
articles.title_cn: 青少年肥胖中的异质性同伴效应与基于性别的干预措施
articles.abstract_en: This paper explores the role of gender heterogeneity in the social diffusion of obesity among adolescents and its policy implications. We propose a social interaction model which allows for gender-dependent heterogeneity in peer effects. Our empirical approach is consistent with the best response functions of a non-cooperative model where social interactions stem from the channel of pure spillover or pure conformity. We estimate the model using data on adolescent Body Mass Index and network-based interactions. Our approach allows us to account for network endogeneity. Our results show that peer effects are gender-dependent, and male students are particularly responsive to the weight of their female friends. According to simulations, reaching out to women results in an 8% increase in effectiveness in reducing overall BMI, based on the most conservative scenario. Thus, female-tailored interventions are likely to be more effective than a gender-neutral approach to fighting obesity in schools.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了性别异质性在青少年肥胖社会扩散中的作用及其政策含义。我们提出了一个社交互动模型，该模型允许同伴效应中存在依赖于性别的异质性。我们的实证方法与一个非合作模型的最佳反应函数一致，其中社交互动源于纯溢出或纯一致性渠道。我们使用青少年身体质量指数和基于网络的互动数据来估计模型。我们的方法使我们能够考虑网络内生性。我们的结果表明，同伴效应是性别依赖的，男学生尤其对女性朋友的体重反应敏感。根据模拟，在最保守的情景下，针对女性的干预措施在降低总体BMI方面的有效性提高了8%。因此，针对女性的干预措施可能比在学校中对抗肥胖的性别中立方法更有效。

articles.title_en: Attentional processes underlying health state valuation with time trade-off and standard gamble tasks
articles.title_cn: 时间权衡与标准博弈任务中健康状态评估背后的注意过程
articles.abstract_en: Time Trade-Off (TTO) and Standard Gamble (SG) tasks are commonly used methods to measure utilities for health states (e.g., diabetes, being in a wheelchair). Importantly, however, the two methods have been shown to typically yield discrepant utilities for a given health state. Here we examine the cognitive processes underlying this utility gap by analyzing individuals’ attentional patterns when evaluating health states in the TTO and SG tasks. In an online experiment, each respondent completed both a TTO and an SG task and we used the process-tracing methodology Mouselab to record respondents’ attention allocation to the tasks’ attributes: health states and their durations (in both TTO and SG), and probabilities (in SG only). In the TTO task, attention was approximately balanced between the health state and duration attributes, whereas in the SG task, attention was focussed on the probability and the health state attributes. Individuals who paid more attention to the task-specific trade-off attribute (i.e., duration and probability in TTO and SG, respectively) seemed to be less willing to make those trade-offs, leading to higher utilities for the health states. Notably, the utility gap was associated with individual differences in attention allocation: respondents who adjusted their attention allocation less to the task-specific trade-offs produced more discrepant utilities between the TTO and SG tasks. Our findings underscore the key role of attentional processes in preference construction, highlighting that differences in the utilities people assign to health states could potentially be influenced by altering attention allocation.
articles.abstract_cn: 时间权衡（TTO）和标准博弈（SG）任务是测量健康状态（如糖尿病、坐轮椅）效用的常用方法。然而，重要的是，这两种方法已被证明对于给定的健康状态通常会产生不一致的效用。在此，我们通过分析个体在TTO和SG任务中评估健康状态时的注意模式，来考察这种效用差距背后的认知过程。在一项在线实验中，每位受访者完成了TTO和SG任务，我们使用过程追踪方法Mouselab记录受访者对任务属性的注意分配：健康状态及其持续时间（在TTO和SG中均有），以及概率（仅在SG中）。在TTO任务中，注意在健康状态和持续时间属性之间大致平衡，而在SG任务中，注意集中在概率和健康状态属性上。那些对任务特定权衡属性（即TTO中的持续时间和SG中的概率）给予更多关注的个体，似乎更不愿意进行这些权衡，从而导致对健康状态的效用更高。值得注意的是，效用差距与个体在注意分配上的差异相关：那些对任务特定权衡调整注意分配较少的受访者，在TTO和SG任务之间产生了更不一致的效用。我们的发现强调了注意过程在偏好构建中的关键作用，表明人们分配给健康状态的效用差异可能通过改变注意分配而受到影响。
